name: mcpImage
description: Builds an image MCP content block. data is a base64-encoded string of the image bytes and mimeType is the image's MIME type (e.g. "image/png"). The block passes through the automatic result coercion untouched, so use it when a tool wants exact control over what the client renders. An omitted mimeType is left out rather than written as null.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type of the image, e.g. "image/png".

links.title: RustCFML MCP documentation
links.description: Content helpers for exact control over MCP responses.

examples.title: Return an image content block
examples.description: Pair a text block with an image block in a single content list.
